notes: Money-moving. Never retried automatically. Settle PENDING and AMBIGUOUS with walletcashin.query after 3 minutes or more, using the same transid.

scenarios.name: in-progress-111
scenarios.description: Result code 111: still processing. Query again after 3 minutes or more.

body.message: Request in progress. You will receive a callback shortly.

scenarios.name: ambiguous-999
scenarios.description: Result code 999: outcome unknown, wait for reconciliation. Never resubmit.

scenarios.name: failure
scenarios.description: Result code 400: any code outside 000, 111, 927, 999 (and 404 on a query) is a failure.

scenarios.name: not-found-404
scenarios.description: Result code 404 on an operation that is not a status query is an ordinary failure, not NOT_FOUND.

scenarios.name: gateway-error-no-json
scenarios.description: No JSON body and no result code. Not a verdict: report AMBIGUOUS, never FAILED.

scenarios.name: in-progress-927
scenarios.description: Result code 927 is also in progress.

scenarios.name: success-blank-result
scenarios.description: Result code 000 with an empty result text is still a success. Classify by resultcode only.

scenarios.name: result-text-ignored
scenarios.description: The result text says SUCCESS but the code is 111. The code wins.
